How Agents Should Use This File

verification.basis: Remote main verified with git ls-remote; independent clean clone matched that exact commit; all listed sources read. Existing dirty, behind local AgentOS checkout was not used as policy source.
verification.upstream_freshness: Verified at initialization; not a continuing freshness guarantee.

cache.kind: scoped summary, not a verbatim mirror or independent policy source

includes: privacy, approval, verification, and portable continuity principles
experiential learning and scoped agent/skill requirements
excludes: unrelated work and personal project context
scope.precedence: Platform rules and explicit user instructions retain precedence; Piano Tutor local requirements, architecture, implementation, and operating procedures override inherited defaults.

learning.mutation_boundary: Record compact sanitized proposals; no automatic edits to agent definitions, skills, code, permissions, approval boundaries, or safety rules. Only policy-allowed deterministic operational state may update automatically in its owning location; none is defined at initialization.
learning.future_agents: Explicit canonical sources, context/state allowlist, permitted learning destination, and mutation boundary required.
learning.future_skills: A compact Post-Run Learning section is required.
learning.promotion: Source-grounded and generalizable; same signal in two runs or retrospective after three meaningful runs. Single high-impact failure requires an explicit reviewed change and proportionate verification. Evidence is not authorization.

refresh_policy.mode: deliberate reviewed refresh only; no scheduled or silent refresh during ordinary development
steps: Inspect Piano Tutor and AgentOS Git state and remotes; preserve unrelated changes. Use an isolated clone if AgentOS is dirty or behind.
Fetch current committed AgentOS main and record its full SHA. If unavailable, report the gap and retain the pinned cache without claiming freshness.
Compare every listed source at the old and new SHA using git diff OLD NEW -- SOURCE_PATHS; inspect relevant newly referenced sources. Separate upstream policy changes from unrelated context.

Read local AGENTS.md, decisions, and state. Assess each applicable upstream change against local scope and precedence; preserve local decisions. Resolve material conflicts with Kyle when authority and context do not resolve them.

Prepare a reviewable change to the scoped summary and provenance together, including new hashes, date, and scope. Apply only within explicit refresh authorization; do not silently promote learning proposals.
Verify paths, hashes, scope, privacy, design exceptions, learning destinations and mutation boundaries; review the Git diff and record any material local override in decisions.

Commit and push only authorized scoped changes under repository rules. If AgentOS tracking needs updating, use a separately authorized tracking change with stable Piano Tutor evidence; regenerate its playbook and run --check.
